front: What are the three aspects of the Golden Triangle?
back: Sport; Media; Commercialisation.
group: The golden triangle

front: How does sport benefit from the Golden Triangle?
back: Increased income from broadcasting and sponsorship; Increased promotion and popularity; Improved organisation and funding; Improved facilities for performers and spectators.
group: The golden triangle

front: How does the media benefit from sport?
back: It gains viewers, readers and advertising revenue.
group: The golden triangle

front: Why is sport considered a highly marketable commodity?
back: It attracts large global audiences and generates significant commercial revenue.
group: The golden triangle

front: Why is television an effective medium for sport?
back: It can broadcast live sporting events instantly to large worldwide audiences.
group: The golden triangle

front: How do subscription channels increase revenue from sport?
back: Viewers pay subscriptions to access exclusive sports coverage.
group: The golden triangle

front: What are ring-fenced sporting events?
back: Major sporting events protected so they remain available on free-to-air television.
group: The golden triangle

front: Why is it important to retain ring-fenced sporting events?
back: They help maintain widespread access to major sporting events regardless of income.
group: The golden triangle

front: Why is sport attractive to media companies?
back: High levels of skill; Visually appealing action and physical challenge; Relatively simple rules; Easy to televise; National relevance; Recognisable personalities and role models.
group: The golden triangle

front: Why is sport attractive as a commercial enterprise?
back: Extensive media coverage; Large audiences and ticket sales; Links to high-profile professional sport; Product endorsements; Advertising, merchandising and sponsorship opportunities; Association with sporting success; Entertainment value.
group: The golden triangle

front: What are some positive effects of media coverage on sport?
back: Increases the profile of sports and performers; Can increase participation; Encourages media-friendly variations; Generates income and attracts sponsors; Can increase standards of performance and behaviour; Can lead to rule changes that increase entertainment.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are some negative effects of media coverage on sport?
back: NGBs and performers can lose control to media and sponsors; Traditional aspects of sport may be lost; Media can influence locations and start times; Excessive coverage can cause spectator boredom; Unequal coverage between sports; Increased demands for interviews and appearances; Negative events may be over-sensationalised.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the advantages of sponsorship and commercial deals for sports performers?
back: Increased wages, prize money and extrinsic rewards; More opportunities for professional and full-time contracts; Greater incentive to maintain discipline and a positive image; Access to high-quality training and specialist equipment.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the disadvantages of sponsorship and commercial deals for sports performers?
back: Increased pressure to win at all costs; Increased risk of deviant behaviour; Performers may be treated as commodities and bought or sold for economic reasons; Performers in minority sports may receive less funding.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: How can the media dictate sporting events?
back: By influencing start times and schedules to maximise viewing figures.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: How can sponsorship change the nature of sport?
back: It can encourage changes such as longer breaks or alterations to rules to create more opportunities for advertising.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: Why can media and sponsorship increase pressure on performers?
back: Performers face greater scrutiny and pressure to succeed in order to maintain contracts, sponsorship and their public image.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: Why must elite performers consider the nature of a sponsor before accepting a deal?
back: The sponsor's values and image may affect the performer's reputation and public perception.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: Why do performers have a social responsibility when choosing sponsors?
back: Their endorsement can promote products or behaviours that affect society.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What expectations might sponsors place on performers?
back: Media appearances, standards of behaviour and expectations of sporting success.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: Why could accepting the wrong sponsor be damaging?
back: Association with a controversial sponsor may damage the performer's image and credibility.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the positive effects of sponsorship on sport?
back: Increased funding for facilities, equipment, coaching and Talent ID; Funding for officiating technology; More positive role models; Increased spectator interest; More events and competitions.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the negative effects of sponsorship on sport?
back: Over-reliance on commercial funding; Unequal funding between sports; Loss of control to commercial organisations; Changes to rules, formats or competitions; Commercial influence over event locations.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the positive effects of increased media coverage and commercialisation on coaches and managers?
back: Higher profile and public awareness; Increased salaries; Greater investment in playing squads, training facilities and support services.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the negative effects of increased media coverage and commercialisation on coaches and managers?
back: Increased pressure to succeed; Greater public expectation; Risk of losing their job following poor results; Increased media commitments; Less funding and opportunity in lower-profile sports.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the positive effects of increased media coverage and commercialisation on officials?
back: Higher profile; Increased salaries and full-time opportunities; Greater investment in training and support; Increased access to decision-making technology.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the negative effects of increased media coverage and commercialisation on officials?
back: Increased pressure to make correct decisions; Greater media scrutiny; Risk of demotion or job loss following mistakes; Unequal access to technology; Potential over-reliance on technology.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the positive effects of increased media coverage on spectators?
back: Higher standards of performance; Improved facilities; Better viewing experiences; Greater access to live sport; More sporting formats; Improved broadcast technology; Increased knowledge and awareness of sport.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people

front: What are the negative effects of increased media coverage on spectators?
back: Increased subscription costs; Loss of sporting traditions; More breaks in play; Fewer tickets for ordinary fans; Changes to start times; Unequal coverage between sports; Higher merchandise costs.
group: Pros and cons of the golden triangle on sport and the people
